units.source_text: 她迅速把右手藏在怀里，摇摇晃晃地站了起来，

en.t: She quickly hid her right hand inside her robe and staggered to her feet,

units.source_text: 想要打开同邻房相隔的隔扇——

en.t: trying to open the sliding screen that separated her from the next room—

units.source_text: 她明知隔扇那边有三个女人正同客人……

en.t: though she knew perfectly well that beyond the screen three women were with customers...
She merely laid her hand on the screen,

units.source_text: 照例在心里狠狠地骂道：“畜生，畜生！”

en.t: and, as usual, cursed fiercely in her heart: "Damn him, damn him!"
Without so much as glancing at the man,

units.source_text: 就出了后门，向沿山谷的小路走去。

en.t: she went out the back door and walked toward the path along the valley.
